svg.text: The mark is a shield (assurance) housing a terminal prompt — security tooling, said plainly. One accent: ember #F57214.
Six directions, each on its dark and light ground. The recommended mark is boxed.
“AI” carries the ember; “Pentest” takes the ink. Horizontal, stacked, and in-console.
Where it lives: the app rail, the favicon at real sizes, and a report masthead.
One accent, warm-graphite neutrals, Inter + JetBrains Mono.
AI Pentest · Terminal Shield — recommended. Six directions supplied light + dark as editable SVG/PNG.
